name: 服务调用中间件
description: 从 Grafana 面板迁移并汉化，已转换为“我的面板”原生格式。来源：service-middleware。

variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: 集群
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope_id AS __value, 
CASE 
  WHEN c.name != '' THEN c.name
  ELSE scope_id
END AS __text
FROM data_scope 
LEFT JOIN clusters c ON scope_id  = c.id
WHERE type = 'cluster'

widgets.title: 平均响应时间
widgets.description: 服务调用中间件平均响应时间(纳秒,按服务名、数据库系统、名称和URL统计)

query.expression: sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_sum{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

queries.expression: sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_sum{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

widgets.title: 请求错误率(%)
widgets.description: 服务调用中间件请求错误率(百分比,按服务名、数据库系统、名称和URL统计)

query.expression: sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service",is_error="true", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))  / sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) or (sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))*0)

queries.expression: sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service",is_error="true", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))  / sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) or (sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (increase(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))*0)

widgets.title: 每秒钟请求数(TPS)
widgets.description: 服务调用中间件每秒请求数(TPS,按服务名、数据库系统、名称和URL统计)

query.expression: sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (irate(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

queries.expression: sum by (svc_name, db_system, db_name, name, db_url) (irate(kindling_db_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))
